# MCP Tool Schema Reference

Generated by `cargo xtask schemas mcp`.

Axon supports legacy, atomic and both tool projections, selected by --mcp-tool-projection or AXON_MCP_TOOL_PROJECTION. Legacy remains the default. The canonical runtime registry owns action metadata, real DTO schemas and leaf-operation discovery; xtask imports that registry rather than mirroring it. The dedicated axon_status_dashboard tool is retained in every mode.

## Actions

| Action | Scope | Mutates | Async | Request DTO | Grouped | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `codex` | admin | true | false | `CodexRequest` | true | Inspect and operate the approval-gated Codex app-server control plane |
| `scrape` | write | true | true | `ScrapeRequest` | false | Project one or more page acquisitions onto the canonical source pipeline |
| `crawl` | write | true | true | `CrawlRequest` | false | Project one or more site crawls onto the canonical source pipeline |
| `embed` | write | true | true | `EmbedRequest` | false | Project one or more embedding requests onto the canonical source pipeline |
| `ingest` | write | true | true | `IngestRequest` | false | Project one or more ingestion requests onto the canonical source pipeline |
| `code_search` | read | false | false | `CodeSearchRequest` | false | Search committed code vectors without refreshing the index |
| `help` | info | false | false | `HelpRequest` | false | List actions, subactions, defaults, and schema resource links |
| `status` | read | false | false | `StatusRequest` | false | Show job queue, worker, and service status |
| `jobs` | write | true | false | `JobsRequest` | true | List, inspect, page events, cancel, retry, recover, cleanup, or clear unified durable jobs |
| `doctor` | read | false | false | `DoctorRequest` | false | Diagnose Axon service connectivity |
| `source` | write | true | true | `SourceRequest` | false | Acquire and index one source (local path, git/web/feed/youtube/reddit/session/registry target) through the unified pipeline |
| `query` | read | false | false | `QueryRequest` | false | Run semantic vector search over indexed content |
| `retrieve` | read | false | false | `RetrieveRequest` | false | Fetch stored document chunks by URL |
| `resolve` | read | false | false | `ResolveRequest` | false | Resolve source identity and adapter route without acquiring content |
| `capabilities` | read | false | false | `CapabilitiesRequest` | false | Machine-readable server capability document: actions, scopes, providers |
| `providers` | read | false | false | `ProvidersRequest` | true | List or inspect provider capability/health (list|get subactions) |
| `search` | read | true | false | `SearchRequest` | false | Run SearXNG/Tavily web search and optionally queue source auto-index jobs for results |
| `map` | read | false | false | `MapRequest` | false | Discover URLs for a site without scraping page content |
| `prune` | admin | true | false | `PruneMcpRequest` | true | Plan or execute source, generation, or collection cleanup behind axon-prune |
| `collections` | read | false | false | `CollectionsMcpRequest` | true | List or inspect configured vector collections |
| `reset` | admin | true | false | `ResetMcpRequest` | true | Plan or execute an explicit clean-slate store reset |
| `ask` | read | true | false | `AskRequest` | false | Answer a question with RAG over indexed content |
| `evaluate` | read | false | false | `EvaluateRequest` | false | Evaluate RAG quality against a baseline and judge diagnostics |
| `suggest` | read | false | false | `SuggestRequest` | false | Suggest new documentation URLs to index |
| `research` | read | true | false | `ResearchRequest` | false | Run SearXNG/Tavily research with synthesis and auto-indexing |
| `screenshot` | write | true | false | `ScreenshotRequest` | false | Capture a full-page screenshot through headless Chrome |
| `brand` | write | true | false | `BrandRequest` | false | Extract brand identity metadata from a URL |
| `diff` | write | true | false | `DiffRequest` | false | Compare two URLs for content, metadata, and link changes |
| `extract` | write | true | true | `ExtractRequest` | true | Start async structured extraction jobs; use action=jobs for lifecycle |
| `memory` | write | true | false | `MemoryRequest` | true | Remember, search, and show persistent agent memory |
| `summarize` | read | false | false | `SummarizeRequest` | false | Fetch URL context and summarize it with the configured LLM |
| `endpoints` | write | true | false | `EndpointsRequest` | false | Discover and optionally verify static site endpoints |
| `watch` | write | true | false | `WatchMcpRequest` | true | Create, list, inspect, update, pause, resume, or delete source-request-backed watches |
| `graph` | read | false | false | `GraphRequest` | true | Query the read-only SourceGraph: kinds, resolve, query, node, edge, source subgraph |
| `uploads` | write | true | false | `UploadsMcpRequest` | true | Stage, inspect, complete, list, or abort durable uploads |
| `artifacts` | read | false | false | `ArtifactsMcpRequest` | true | List, inspect, or read artifacts by opaque artifact id |
| `chat` | read | false | false | `ChatRequest` | false | Send a direct prompt to the configured chat-purpose LLM |

## Subactions

| Action | Subactions |
|---|---|
| `codex` | `approve`, `cancel`, `events`, `execute`, `operations`, `prepare`, `reconcile`, `resource`, `respond`, `snapshot` |
| `jobs` | `cancel`, `cleanup`, `clear`, `events`, `get`, `list`, `recover`, `retry`, `status`, `stream` |
| `providers` | `get`, `list` |
| `prune` | `exec`, `get`, `plan` |
| `collections` | `get`, `list` |
| `reset` | `exec`, `get`, `plan` |
| `extract` | `start` |
| `memory` | `archive`, `compact`, `context`, `contradict`, `export`, `forget`, `import`, `link`, `list`, `pin`, `reinforce`, `remember`, `review`, `search`, `show`, `supersede` |
| `watch` | `create`, `delete`, `exec`, `get`, `history`, `list`, `pause`, `resume`, `status`, `update` |
| `graph` | `edge`, `kinds`, `node`, `query`, `resolve`, `source` |
| `uploads` | `abort`, `complete`, `create`, `get`, `list`, `put_content` |
| `artifacts` | `content`, `get`, `list` |

## Canonical leaf tools

Atomic calls omit action and subaction: the tool name fixes both. Safety hints do not grant permissions. Search and research require explicit write elevation; extract_start alone supports optional MCP task admission. The generated JSON exports each focused schema and all reachable definitions.

## Response Envelope

Every response uses `AxonToolResponse` (see `$defs.AxonToolResponse` in the generated JSON schema) — `ok`, `action`, `subaction`, `request_id`, `contract_version`, `data`, `warnings`, and optional `job`/`watch`/`artifacts`/`pagination`/`trace`.
